event.stage_position_scope: Numbers identify selected conceptual stages only. The lumped model predicts no dependence on their physical locations.
event.mode_note: A conductive bypass excludes the selected stage capacitor and its per-stage front/tail sections. This is an explicitly altered topology, not a spark gap that fails to close.
event.unsupported_failure: A spark gap that does not fire can leave an open chain; its distributed transient is not represented by either supported mode.

energy.bypassed_capacitor_charge_note: Excluded capacitors can retain physical stored charge; bypass does not establish discharge or safety.
energy.fault_input_scope: Energy in modeled contributing stages only; excluded original capacitors may retain charge and their residual energy is unverified.
energy.definition: Healthy input energy describes the original charged bank. Fault input energy includes only modeled contributing stages; excluded original capacitors may retain charge and their residual energy is unverified. The bypass does not establish discharge. Original contributing-stage charge is not reoptimized.

assumptions: Generated hypothetical experiment; no measured waveform or laboratory fault validation.
Saved recommended charge is held fixed. No target matching or optimization is performed in the fault experiment.
Lumped series Marx equivalent: Cg = Cstage / active stages, total front and tail resistance = stages × per-stage value.
The loss factor multiplies the erected source voltage once, as in the existing circuit model.
limitations: Spark-gap delay, arc voltage, distributed capacitance, electromagnetic fields and location-dependent stage faults are not modeled.
These simulations do not establish IEC chopped-impulse compliance or real CPRI accuracy.
Predicted current, reversal and energy are conditional on assumed R/L values; no component pulse rating or safe-to-fire decision is supplied.
Physical experiments require authorized qualified personnel and the laboratory’s approved procedures, barriers, interlocks and stored-energy controls.
